text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki is the daughter of a famous stage actor, but she has chosen to go down the path of racing rather than theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her path may be different, but with her eyes set on a destination only she can reach, she is just as determined to make her fans proud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First on the list is conquering the Classic Triple Crown. Then, it's becoming an unrivaled entertainer. Fuji Kiseki's journey to achieve her lofty goals starts now!
